product_name: Áo Khoác Blazer Nữ Form Rộng Phong Cách Hàn Quốc Vải Tuyết Mưa

concept_options.title: Thử Thách Vo Tròn Áo Blazer 289K
concept_options.target_audience_segment: Gen Z & Young Office Women skeptical of cheap online fashion quality

hook_strategy.spoken_hook: Áo blazer 289K mà dám vắt khô như khăn lau thế này?
hook_strategy.visual_hook: Presenter aggressively wrings and crushes the blazer into a tight ball live on camera before snapping it open.
hook_strategy.on_screen_text: BÀI TEST PHÁ HOẠI: BLAZER 289K CÓ NĂN?
hook_strategy.retention_trigger: Visual destruction of a fashion item paired with curiosity over fabric resilience.

narrative_arc: 0-3s: Presenter violently twists the blazer into a tight ball, demonstrating extreme fabric stress.
3-7s: Agitates common nightmare of buying online blazers that look like crumpled rags after 10 minutes of sitting.
7-15s: Snaps the blazer open—zero wrinkles. Puts it on in 3 seconds to reveal structured shoulder pads and flawless flow.
15-20s: Close-up macro showing breathability and anti-pilling scratch test on Tuyet Mua fabric.
20-25s: Direct CTA emphasizing the 36% discount price point of 289,000 VND available in the TikTok Shop basket.
concept_options.conversion_thesis: Neutralizes quality skepticism instantly through an unscripted, extreme physical stress test that proves high durability.

concept_options.title: Cảm Nhận Chuẩn Korean Vibe 289K
concept_options.target_audience_segment: Aesthetic-driven, visual shoppers seeking luxury look on a budget

hook_strategy.spoken_hook: Chỉ 3 giây để nâng tầm outfit công sở mỗi sáng.
hook_strategy.visual_hook: Macro camera glide across the crisp Tuyet Mua weave with tactile fabric audio friction.
hook_strategy.retention_trigger: High-end visual satisfaction and ASMR sensory appeal.

narrative_arc: 0-3s: Crisp ASMR fabric brush and sound of shoulder pad snaps aligning in cinematic golden hour lighting.
3-7s: Model gracefully steps into frame, showing fluid movement and effortless drape while walking.
7-15s: Rapid aesthetic transition through 3 styling options: professional office, casual tee, and chic weekend night out.
15-20s: Close-up detailing on pristine inner lining, double-stitched seams, and non-bulky shoulder structure.
20-25s: On-screen price reveal (289K) with soft voiceover prompt to tap the yellow cart.
concept_options.conversion_thesis: Elevates perceived value to 3x price point via high-production sensory aesthetics, triggering impulse purchases.

concept_options.title: Giải Cứu Bắp Tay To & Bụng Mỡ 3 Giây
concept_options.target_audience_segment: Office workers self-conscious about body shape and practical commute wear

hook_strategy.spoken_hook: Bắp tay to với bụng mỡ làm bạn sợ mặc blazer?
hook_strategy.visual_hook: Split screen: tight rigid jacket emphasizing body flaws vs throwing on the oversized blazer for an instant slim look.
hook_strategy.on_screen_text: HACK DÁNG CÔNG SỞ: TRƯỚC & SAU 3S
hook_strategy.retention_trigger: Relatable body insecurity and instantaneous visual transformation.

narrative_arc: 0-3s: Side-by-side comparison highlighting uncomfortable tight blazer vs relaxed Korean oversized silhouette.
3-7s: Agitates everyday misery: office sitting causing belly bulges and sweaty, creased sleeves during motorbike commutes.
7-15s: Demonstrates smart Korean oversized tailoring hiding arm fat and waistline while maintaining formal elegance.
15-20s: Motorbike commute test: presenter puts helmet on, rides, and arrives completely wrinkle-free and cool.
20-25s: Value tear-down CTA: 'Full outfit transformation for just 289,000 VND - order today before sale ends!'
concept_options.conversion_thesis: Targets acute everyday pain points (body image, tropical motorbike commuting) with clear side-by-side proof of utility.

winning_concept.selection_rationale: In the low-cost apparel segment (289,000 VND), the primary conversion blocker is consumer skepticism regarding fabric quality and wrinkling. Angle A's violent 'ball-up stress test' acts as a high-stopping-power pattern interrupt on social feeds while simultaneously destroying the biggest purchasing objection in the first 3 seconds.

directorial_directives.camera_pacing: Fast kinetic whip-pan into tight handheld frame for the stress test, stabilizing into locked medium tracking shot during wear demo.
directorial_directives.lighting_mood: High-key studio commercial lighting with subtle rim light to capture fabric texture details and zero shadows on the jacket surface.
directorial_directives.key_visual_anchor: The physical uncurling of the crumpled blazer revealing an instantaneous wrinkle-free surface.
